caribbean.headline: Roatan Faces Choppy Seas and Heavy Rain Today
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing ESE winds to 21 kt, seas near 4.3 ft with an ENE swell period of 8 s, and 75% rain probability at the port. St. Lucia is seeing lighter winds to 11 kt and generally calmer seas, and I advise mariners to exercise caution near Roatan where 4.3 ft seas and 21 kt winds may produce choppy conditions and localized heavy showers.

mediterranean.headline: Lisbon Weather: Heavy Rain and 6.4 ft Seas
mediterranean.paragraph: Lisbon is experiencing heavy rain with 75% rain probability, southerly winds near 13 kt and seas to 6.4 ft on a 10 s WNW swell. Barcelona has lighter winds around 10 kt, and I expect the heaviest precipitation to remain focused near Lisbon through this afternoon.
